spec_features.spec_quote: If the agent emits no text and no tool calls for two consecutive turns, we end the run and flag `gave_up`
spec_features.evidence: harness.py: stall_count increments when `not assistant.tool_calls and not (assistant.content or "").strip()` (line ~182); default `max_stall: int = 2` (line 48); termination `if stall_count >= cfg.max_stall: gave_up = True; break` (lines 188-190). This actually breaks the loop and sets result.gave_up (line 196). max_stall is not overridden by ExperimentConfig, so it stays 2 (two consecutive empty turns).
spec_features.notes: Fully enforced end-to-end: condition checked, loop broken, gave_up flag set and persisted/logged in runner.py:111. Note: text _GIVEUP_MARKERS also set gave_up=True (line 169) but do NOT break the loop; only the stall path is the actual hard stop.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: max_stall: int = 2  # consecutive empty turns before bailing

spec_features.evidence: configs/experiment.yaml:32 `max_turns: 14`; runner.py builds HarnessConfig(max_turns=cfg.max_turns) (line 101-104); harness.py loops `for turn in range(1, cfg.max_turns + 1):` so the loop is bounded and exits when the budget is exhausted. n_turns_requested recorded from cfg.max_turns.
spec_features.notes: The dataclass default in code is max_turns=12 (ExperimentConfig) / 12 (HarnessConfig); the real YAML config sets 14 and the CLI demo sets 8. The cap is genuinely the loop bound, fully enforced.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: max_turns: 14      # enough turns for a trajectory to develop
